status: Prospective pilot proposal, not an executable or authorized training run

evidence.interpretation: Below-2m supervision was absent. Too-far bias at close range and too-close average bias at 4-6m indicate range compression, not evidence for one global offset. This is a hypothesis about supervision, not proof of a single cause.

unchanged.architecture: Shared Urban nano body + metric depth decoder + actual-camera residual adapter width 16
freeze: all BatchNorm affine weights and running state
unchanged.trainable: Existing 1553 camera-adapter parameters only for the first pilot
unchanged.note: If adapter-only training cannot improve the range response, a separately approved joint depth-decoder pilot can follow; it is not bundled into this test.

cpu_input_preparation.near_reference: The same conservative object-owned positive camera-axis Z policy as the frozen benchmark, including measured depths below 2m. Do not relabel sparse holes or use object centre depth as surface truth.
cpu_input_preparation.selection: GT-only deterministic six-cell/log-balanced selection. Retain rare eligible Pedestrian 0-2m and Vehicle/Pedestrian 0-1m views before hashed fill; preserve rare examples, not a claim of adequate 0-1m support. Report the unique keyframes, tracks and logs per cell/camera. No prediction-based image selection.
cpu_input_preparation.leakage_policy: Keep all dev, held-out and excluded recording logs out of training. The fixed 512 development images are evaluation-only, not training or feature-target inputs. Held-out bodies remain unopened.
cpu_input_preparation.camera_policy: Cover all available camera channels. Explicitly flag missing cells, especially front-facing 0-2m; do not treat another camera as evidence for front-camera coverage.
cpu_input_preparation.broad_protection: Retain conservative 2-80m training references for the broad loss where available. Keep nearest-return z-buffering and timing/edge guards before range filtering.
cpu_input_preparation.io_policy: CPU-only preparation from completed coverage chunks and immutable source archives. Read each source archive sequentially once, build bounded reusable zipped shards, copy those to local Colab disk before GPU use, and batch progress archives. Do not repeat small mounted-Drive reads.
cpu_input_preparation.readiness: Freeze and verify the exact input manifest, per-cell/camera/log support and data hashes before creating a GPU run. Missing near cells stop the proposed six-cell pilot; scarce cells remain explicitly scarce.

matched_pilot.initialization: Both arms restart from unchanged V0 epoch-4 tensors with fresh optimizer state and identical seeded training streams

arms.continuation_2_6_control: 0.8 times equal mean of the original four 2-6m class/range Huber components, plus 0.2 broad 2-80m Huber. Newly available 0-2m labels do not contribute to this arm.
arms.six_cell_0_6_candidate: 0.8 times equal mean of the six Vehicle/Pedestrian x 0-2/2-4/4-6m Huber components, plus 0.2 broad 2-80m Huber. This isolates adding close-range supervision from extra continuation steps.

matched_pilot.sampler: Eight image draws per update: one from each of six near cells plus two broad draws, identical in both arms. Within a near cell draw recording log, track, observation and camera with equal hierarchical probabilities; log all draws and unique support. Repeated images are allowed and reported.
matched_pilot.loss_aggregation: Within a near component equal object-camera observations inside each image, then equal images; compensate remaining log/track density through the declared sampler. This training objective is not claimed identical to the evaluation hierarchy. No hard class weighting is needed beyond the equal six-cell components in this first test.
matched_pilot.budget_note: A block is 384 optimizer updates, not a full pass through all 4096 images. No automatic extension. Identical arms separate the new range supervision from continuation effects.
matched_pilot.selection: Keep epoch zero and all five block endpoints. Select lowest frozen development primary 2-6m score, ties to earlier endpoints; also report fixed block-5 results and every 0-2m secondary cell. An improvement in conditional MAE alone cannot hide lost prediction coverage or range/class regressions.
matched_pilot.interpretation: Report gains relative to both frozen V0 and the matched continuation control. New training-data selection and loss are changed, so gains are not attributed to any one mechanism beyond the matched loss comparison.

evaluation.secondary: Vehicle/Pedestrian 0-2m MAE, signed bias, support and prediction coverage
evaluation.exploratory: 0-1m remains exploratory; no reliable front-camera 0-2m result exists in the current dev selection
evaluation.paired: Identical frozen GT point masks; publish own-valid and common-valid V0/V1 results
evaluation.holdout: Only after development review and final candidate freeze, with separate authorization; no tuning on held-out results
evaluation.phone: Export and remeasure unchanged-architecture candidate separately only after numerical and development review
